overview.tags: dark fantasy, crystal, oathbound, living fortress
overview.concept: An oathbound sovereign awakens a living crystal fortress whose masked denizens turn memory, discipline, and stormlight into enduring power.

queens_vault.style: Gothic halls of dark crystal, silver filigree, vaulted mirrors, and contained stormlight
queens_vault.population_appearance: Tall masked figures formed from smoke-dark crystal and silver latticework, with pale stormlight moving beneath their translucent surfaces.
queens_vault.description: Queen's Vault is a silent living citadel of reflective galleries, oath-marked arches, and deep crystalline chambers. Every surface records faint impressions of duty, memory, and authority.
queens_vault.manifestation: Structures grow through interlocking crystal planes, tools form from folded silver light, and the Veiled Court condenses from reflections when the Dungeon requires workers, attendants, or defenders.
queens_vault.throne_room: A circular chamber of black crystal surrounds a silver throne beneath a captive indoor storm. Fine oath-script glows across the floor whenever the Thronebound invokes the Dungeon System.

dungeon_resources.construction_description: A dark crystalline material that hardens around clearly defined purpose and remembered obligation.
dungeon_resources.construction_collection: The Dungeon grows Vowglass along prepared lattice beds, where Workers harvest mature planes without damaging the underlying pattern.
dungeon_resources.construction_use: It pays for facilities, Expansion, Tier Ups, structural reinforcement, and the physical forms of Dungeon equipment.
dungeon_resources.sustenance_description: A cool silver fluid carrying stable impressions of rest, identity, and collective belonging.
dungeon_resources.sustenance_collection: Quiet galleries condense it from the harmless memories shed by the Veiled Court during work and recovery.
dungeon_resources.sustenance_use: It pays population upkeep and restores the cohesion, resilience, and recovery of Dungeon-created cohorts.
dungeon_resources.development_description: Concentrated harmonic force produced when a Dungeon bond, personal oath, or practiced ability becomes more coherent.
dungeon_resources.development_collection: The Development Sanctum refines it from training echoes, completed duties, research insights, and strengthened bonds.
dungeon_resources.development_use: It supports Thronebound and Administrator growth, Classes, abilities, Bond advancement, Rank development, and research.
dungeon_resources.energy_description: The ungraded storm-bright currency through which Queen's Vault expresses immediate Dungeon authority.
dungeon_resources.energy_collection: The Dungeon channels Crownlight from the captive storm above the throne and circulates it through silver conduits.
dungeon_resources.energy_use: It is the primary Dungeon currency for construction, facility operation, upgrades, summoning, training, research, portals, and Tier advancement.

maraveil.appearance: Mara-Veil is a tall human woman with deep brown skin, silver-black hair, pale stormlit eyes, and ceremonial armor traced with the same oath-script found throughout Queen's Vault.
maraveil.personality: Measured, protective, exacting, and deeply attentive to promises, with little patience for authority that cannot justify itself.
maraveil.background: Mara-Veil served as the last sworn warden of a failing Caelan fortress-state. She accepted the Dungeon bond while searching for a durable refuge for the people and obligations she refused to abandon.
maraveil.capabilities: She possesses formal command training, defensive swordsmanship, legal and logistical education, storm-channeling rituals, and practical experience managing a fortified estate.
maraveil.values: She values kept promises, competent stewardship, chosen loyalty, personal sovereignty, and protecting those who accept her authority in good faith.
maraveil.voice_pattern: Mara-Veil speaks in concise formal sentences, states conditions explicitly, and rarely uses casual contractions.

unique_attributes.primary_description: The Dungeon turns clearly accepted promises and responsibilities into stable authority that strengthens its linked systems and Administrators.
unique_attributes.secondary_description: Dungeon structures preserve useful impressions of work, training, and prior configurations without replacing personal memory.
unique_attributes.tertiary_description: The Dungeon efficiently channels volatile magical force through ordered structures, facilities, and bonded individuals.

attribute_growth_preference.favored_attributes: Command, Logistics, Endurance, Oath Dominion, Storm Conduction

homeworld.description: Caelus is a storm-wrapped world of floating basalt continents, fortified city-states, ritual weathercraft, windborne trade, and oath-governed magical institutions.
homeworld.region: The Vesper Crown, a chain of inhabited fortress-islands surrounding an ancient permanent cyclone.
homeworld.primary_anchor: The western gate court of Mara-Veil's former citadel, overlooking the lightning farms of Vesper Reach.
homeworld.residence: A private warden's apartment within the citadel's western tower.
homeworld.time_period: The 312th Year of the Tempest Concord
homeworld.current_circumstances: The Vesper Crown is recovering from the collapse of its central alliance while rival city-states compete for abandoned defenses, trade routes, and surviving weather engines.
